proposed_branch: Retain the indexed primitive P1 cell, swap the submitted Pb2 and Au1 heavy-site assignments, and independently re-solve/refine the four oxygen sites against the whole profile.
reason: The submitted CIF is valid and primitive P1, expands to fully occupied Pb2Au2O4 (8 atoms, Z=2), has no overlap (minimum periodic distance 1.800 A), and its cell covers all 107 detected reflections within 0.030 degrees. The trace also evaluates this instantiated model: profile cosine loss 0.01334 versus a free-line lower bound of 0.00908, with 57 isolated intensities correlated at 0.99873; P-1 is strongly worse. However, exact ordering and oxygen coordinates are not established. Independent P1 oxygen searches/refinements end in materially different non-overlapping coordinate minima with very similar profile/stick losses, and the trace never tests Pb/Au permutations despite their similar scattering. A blind whole-profile permutation check leaves the concrete Pb2/Au1 site swap essentially tied (R-like residual 0.09976 versus 0.09970 for the submission), with no stoichiometric, occupancy, overlap, or charge-balance veto. Another attempt focused on same-cell ordering and independent oxygen refinement is therefore likely to add a materially different viable candidate.
